title: From a delivery to a sold card
target: The chain in TCG Card Shop Simulator that turns a box on the floor into money in the till, step by step, using the shop's own behaviour.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)

steps.do: Decide what stays sealed and what you open.
steps.because: packaging boxes exist in separate kinds for cards, items and shelves (InteractablePackagingBox_Card, InteractablePackagingBox_Item)

steps.do: Open in bulk with the machine when you have the option.
steps.because: an automatic opener exists and keeps its own progress (InteractableAutoPackOpener, AutoPackOpenerSaveData)

steps.do: Price every card before it goes out.
steps.because: prices are attached through price tag objects (InteractableCardPriceTag, CheckPriceScreen)

steps.do: Keep the shelf full, because a shelf sells only what it holds.
steps.because: shelf contents are tracked by a manager (ShelfManager)

commonMistakes: Forgetting that sealed stock can also be sold.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
